remarks: Welcome to Bellanti Manor, the next generation of custom homes and the first new home development in Collins, NY since the 1990s. Bellanti Manor will feature six quality built homes on Flavia Circle and Danna Drive, adjacent to the well established Smithcrest and Seneca Heights subdivisions. One home on Danna Drive has already been sold, while another homesite remains available and ready to be built. These thoughtfully designed ranch homes offer 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and practical, open concept layouts with customizable options to fit your lifestyle. Situated on approximately ½ acre with a new septic system, each home features quality craftsmanship and modern finishes throughout. Exterior features include an architectural shingle roof, while interior finishes including flooring, cabinetry, countertops, paint colors, and other selections can be personalized at our design center in the Village of Gowanda. The model home is complete and ready to be shown. Taxes are to be determined following completion of construction and reassessment.
